Switches the display off at night, as the power button does. openframe uses no other permission of device administration.
openframe needs this to switch the display off by the schedule, as the power button does. It can do nothing else with it. Deactivate it in the frame menu before uninstalling openframe.
Stop allowing the display schedule? The display stays on until you allow it again. openframe can then be uninstalled.
Unpair all devices? Every browser has to pair again with a new code.
openframe stopped showing photos after repeated crashes. Open %1$s in a browser and choose “Start normally”, or press a corner of the screen for three seconds and choose it in the menu.
openframe stopped showing photos after repeated crashes. Press a corner of the screen for three seconds and choose “Start normally” in the menu.
